summary: The diff contains only backend files: a new migration module (backend/migration.mo) adding countdownState, a partially shown backend/main.mo with countdown/music/settings types, and a project_state.json tracking planned work. All four requirements are marked 'pending' in project_state.json, meaning no frontend implementation has been delivered. The diff shows backend data-model scaffolding for REQ-2 (music blob in Settings) and REQ-3 (CountdownState), but no frontend components, hooks, or UI changes are present for any of REQ-1 through REQ-4.

missing_requirements.requirement: Music upload in AdminSettings; file saved to backend as blob; all users auto-load/loop track; play/pause button in top-right of top nav; button hidden if no music; useBackgroundMusic wired to backend.
